tenderSchedule.description: Repair/ re conditioning of damaged/worn out turbine spares of VUGPH as outlined in Section 7 of the tender document
tenderSchedule.locationName: KPCL Executive Engineer Turbine Office SVP VARAHI

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka or any State Government or Government of India or Union Territory
Bidders shall ensure upload of all relevant documents as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall be a regular contractor/ authorized agency/firm that has carried out at least one similar work related to Turbine and its auxiliaries of more than 60MW capacity generating Unit in Govt. organizations/Public Sector Undertakings/Reputed organizations, in the preceding 5 financial years in any industry/ utility in India. In proof Bidder shall furnish work order copy of a single work carried out by the bidder of value not less than Rs. 5.19 Lakhs and work done certificate issued from the competent authority (Work done amount of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- work order copy of a single work carried out of value not less than Rs. 5.19 Lakhs and work done certificate issued from the competent authority

technicalCriterionList.description: The intending bidder shall have achieved a minimum average annual financial turnover of Rs.10.38 Lakhs in any two financial years in the preceding five completed financial years, i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26. (Financial turnover of previous years will be given weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the present price level)
